_comment: The apps on /apps. availability: request (a Request access button) or showcase (shown, no button). request: where the button goes, an address per language, when the app has its own contact form (Aresium's on aresium.de); without it, the Ares Empire's general form (site.json links.contact). repo: the GitHub URL once the code is public, else null. demo: a page to try it without an account (Aresium's /demo), else absent. shots: for each look of the site, [front, back] pictures from empire-ios/showcase/<id>/ (import them with tools/import-showcase.py); a look without its own pair uses dark's. Accents are the apps' own (empire-ios Shared/Design: AppAccent; Aresium's red).
